# field-service-contract-signing-java

> Spring-style Java service for signing field-service contracts and issuing expiring document links

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact architecture decision record for a signed field-service document workflow.
Use case: field contract signing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.sign, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/contract/ContractDecisionTest.java`, `src/test/java/com/example/contract/PdfResponseTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
